description: This Java source file contains an abstract class 'JmsBasedRequestResponseClient' which implements request-response communication over JMS for the Hono framework. It manages JMS connections, message creation, sending, and response handling for request-response operations, including error handling and message parsing.

classes.name: JmsBasedRequestResponseClient
classes.description: An abstract class facilitating request-response communication over JMS, including connection setup, message creation, sending, and response handling for the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: createLinks
methods.description: Initializes JMS producer and consumer links for communication.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates a JMS message producer for the target address.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a JMS message consumer for the reply address with a message listener.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a binary JMS message, either empty or with JSON payload.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a JMS message and registers a future for response handling.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a request, reporting failure.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming response messages based on status code.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Processes successful responses and converts payloads into result objects.

methods.name: handleFailure
methods.description: Processes error responses and creates appropriate exceptions.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Abstract method to parse response payload into a result object.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes JMS connection and resources.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Indicates if the connection is open.

methods.name: setRequestTimeout
methods.description: Method not supported; throws exception.

methods.name: getCredit
methods.description: Returns the current credit (set to 1).

methods.name: sendQueueDrainHandler
methods.description: Not supported for JMS; throws exception.

methods.name: getCacheDirective
methods.description: Extracts cache directive from message properties.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves status code from a response message.

methods.name: getStringProperty
methods.description: Utility to get string property from a JMS message.

methods.name: getCorrelationID
methods.description: Retrieves correlation ID from a message.

methods.name: getMessageID
methods.description: Retrieves message ID from a JMS message.

methods.name: getServiceInvocationException
methods.description: Maps exceptions to Hono-specific ServiceInvocationException instances.
